REF rheometer TC90=381s and its method context are now transcribed; this does not establish the exact press hold or chemical conversion.

records.title: Sustainable Reinforcement for Rubbers—Potential Application of Recycled Carbon Fibers
claim_notes: Published version of record hosted by authors’ university department; 12 PDF pages (61276–61287). Download watermark dated 2025-12-29; metadata creation 2025-12-12 UTC.

Retained numerical-source PDF SHA-256 6922d25630c21c03062722a3efdf621b87129c40f06097625161364151c87aef belongs to https://www.pt.bme.hu/publikaciok/2010_publ_sustainable-reinforcement-for-rubbers-potential-application-of-recycled-carbon-fibers_1229.pdf.

License CC-BY-4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Selected original facts are transcribed with original project scope notes; no source assets are bundled or relicensed under project MIT.
Figure 1 is third-party Ceresana material with a separate permission credit. No such figure or third-party values are proposed. REF density is the authors’ own reported measurement in section 3.4.

Density method, temperature, conditioning, replicate count, and plus-minus statistic are not stated specifically for the density measurements in the inspected paper. Do not infer them from mechanical-test procedures.
Materials text identifies the matrix as PERBUNAN 3445 F; Table 2 abbreviates its trade name to Perbunan 3445. Preserve the specific text identification with this alias.

2026-11-03 primary XML supplement: REF Table 4 tensile mean 6.01 ± 1.15 MPa, pooled across orientations, unknown tensile ± type and count. Existing REF density stays unchanged and does not inherit tensile methods/statistics. Six older composite-property discrepancy notes now explicitly limit REF comparator wording to the corresponding record; all numerical/statistical fields unchanged. Abstract 15% improvement claim remains contradicted by Table 4 D5.33 versus REF6.01. Fresh XML inspected; university PDF retrieval failed, so the old PDF digest is not a new acquisition or visual-review claim.

2026-11-03 REF M100/M200 supplement: direct Table4 stress values plus source100%/200% elongation targets, not slope moduli or recalculated secants. ISO37 edition used by authors remains unknown; current terminology references are not compliance certification. Per-target participants, estimator, extraction/averaging order and ± type remain unspecified. Existing density and tensile-strength facts unchanged.
